snippet.title: 868-BACK trailer | Thinky Direct 2025
snippet.description:
868-BACK is a computer-hacking strategy game. Sneak into servers, steal glittering data, fight hostile tasks, expose the megacorps, and find the Mainframe.

This is the first ever trailer for 868-BACK, revealed exclusively for the Thinky Direct 2025.

868-BACK in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/868-back/

868-BACK on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3304110/868BACK/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkgames.com/direct/
